subject.title: SECURITY.md links to private vulnerability reporting, but it is disabled on the repo

question: Which monitored private vulnerability-reporting channel should Crabbox officially support, and who owns its triage?
rationale: The repository cannot safely advertise an email or enable and operate GitHub private reporting without an administrator confirming access, monitoring, and disclosure ownership.

options.title: Enable PVR plus fallback
options.body: Enable GitHub private vulnerability reporting and document a monitored fallback security contact in SECURITY.md.

options.title: Document monitored email only
options.body: Replace the disabled GitHub route with an explicitly approved and monitored security email address.

recommendation.title: Enable PVR plus fallback
recommendation.body: Enable GitHub private vulnerability reporting and document a monitored fallback security contact in SECURITY.md.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release ownership makes steipete the best available candidate to route the repository-setting and disclosure-policy decision.
